comparator: a competent analyst with the same anchors, detections, loss, tolerance and admitted readings, an ordinary matcher, the freedom to abstain and the freedom to ask adaptive questions

computation.against_the_analyst: the analyst runs one matcher per reading. Building the enclosure runs the same matchers over the same readings, so the work is the same order and the measured times are close
computation.basis: mean over repeated builds, machine dependent
computation.unit: milliseconds of command time per case on one machine

human_effort.basis: no person has run either method on this cohort. Command time is not human effort and is not offered as a proxy for it

integration.against_the_analyst: the analyst integrates nothing and trusts their own matcher. Four modules is a real cost this lane imposes and does not recover unless the checking is wanted
integration.basis: read from the import statements of the four modules
integration.unit: modules a consumer must trust, and what they share

shared_trusted_surface: the identifier and rational string conventions

interpretation.against_the_analyst: this is where the lane earns something measurable. The list is shorter and both of its ends are checkable in linear time
interpretation.basis: the disputed set against the checkable cover, both recomputed by the checker
interpretation.unit: reading facts the lead is handed to go and settle

preparation.against_the_analyst: the analyst prepares the same readings. The preparation is shared and this lane earns nothing here
preparation.basis: each case is a committed JSON file with a digest recorded above
preparation.unit: case files written and retained before any result

repair.against_the_analyst: an analyst carries the same risk without a register. The register is a cost here and a discipline, not an advantage claimed over anyone
repair.basis: the standing headline register, which blocks a headline its own evidence refutes
repair.unit: claims this lane has withdrawn or qualified after retained counterexamples

where_it_is_behind: verification on a small cohort, measured slower than recomputation below about 60 detections
where_it_is_level: the verdict itself, which the equivalence makes identical on a finite cohort
where_this_lane_is_ahead: the observation list, shorter and checkable both ways

verification.against_the_analyst: on these retained cases the certificate is slower than recomputing. It overtakes recomputation between 30 and 90 detections and reaches about 4.7 times faster at 900
verification.unit: milliseconds of command time per case, checker against recomputation

decision: delta = (a + b) * (TP_augmented - TP_base) - b * r over a weighted cohort
limits: every verdict here is over admitted readings, never over the physical world
the live comparison remains open at [-8, 8] and no reading is invented for it
no person has run the comparator, so every human cost stays unmeasured
the observation list is a function of the shared readings, so the analyst could compute it too. What is measured is its length and its checkability, not exclusivity
the exact shortest list is only searched below a declared budget; past it the report brackets rather than claims

runtime.note: command timings on one machine. No human effort is measured here

synthetic_conformance.scope: a generator written in this lane. The shares describe these instances only. No claim is made about how often a real cohort is already decided
